description: This file contains an extension for the ChannelsStore class, providing lifecycle and communication methods for managing channels such as WhatsApp and Telegram, including start/stop operations, refresh logic, login sequences, logout procedures, and result handling.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginStartResult
classes.description: Encodes the result of starting a WhatsApp login, including QR code data URL and message.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginWaitResult
classes.description: Encodes the result of waiting for a WhatsApp login, including connection status and message.

classes.name: ChannelLogoutResult
classes.description: Encodes the result of a channel logout attempt, including channel info and whether credentials were cleared.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the polling task to periodically refresh channel status, unless in preview mode or task already running.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the channel status by requesting data from the gateway, updates snapshot and error info.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Initiates WhatsApp login process, optionally auto-waits for connection, updates login message and QR data.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for WhatsApp login completion within a timeout, updates login status and connection info.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out from WhatsApp channel, clears credentials, updates status.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out from Telegram channel, clears token if set, updates config status.
